sentence: This project builds aerosol delivery systems for polymyxin combinations to treat deadly lung infections caused by Gram-negative superbugs.
This project tries to find out how a substance made by gut microbes helps a type of immune cell fight tumors.
This project builds a deep learning algorithm that finds signs of cognitive impairment in electronic health records.
This project engineers Salmonella to deliver antigens into cancer cells and help the immune system attack tumors.
This project builds imaging markers that describe the status of people at risk of Alzheimer's disease and tracks brain atrophy.
This project studies how axons and nerve terminals break down and how synapses are lost in the Alzheimer's disease brain.
This project tries to find out how an enzyme helps the brain clear harmful chemicals during anesthesia and speeds up recovery.
This project studies how a chromatin regulator binds to histone serotonylation and shapes gene expression during neurodevelopment.
This project studies how an unstructured protein region in leukemia-associated proteins helps tumors develop and grow aggressively.
This project uses machine learning to find what predicts why some older adults keep stable cognitive health while others decline.
This project sets up an instrument to study molecular machines that bind and process DNA, and proteins that mediate cell-cell interactions.
This project builds imaging and optogenetics tools to watch and control chromosome segregation in cancer organoids from patients.
This project tries to define treatment-resistant insomnia and find its prevalence, risks and genetic links using data from two large biobanks.
This project builds a web-based knowledgebase that gathers musculoskeletal genetic and genomic data for the study of osteoporosis and osteoarthritis.
This project uses Drosophila neural stem cell lineages to study genes and mechanisms behind the making of diverse brain cells.
This project tests whether a histone demethylase is a good drug target in melanoma and how it affects anti-tumor immunity.
This project tests whether nasal delivery of extracellular vesicles from neural stem cells keeps memory and cognitive function in aged mice.
This project provides genetically altered mice, including CRISPR mice, so researchers can study diabetes and its complications.
This project studies how developmental neuroscience, brain imaging, genetics, the gut microbiome and sleep relate to mental illness in children.
This project studies the molecular links between cell division and differentiation in embryonic stem cells to help control differentiation.
